name: futurama-maker
description: Serviço local de renderização de vídeos para WhatsApp

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @futurama/commands run build && pnpm --filter @futurama/templates run build && pnpm --filter @futurama/core run build && pnpm --filter @futurama/whatsapp run build && pnpm --filter @futurama/dashboard run build
scripts.desktop:dist: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @futurama/desktop run dist
